title: Blood Lotus Essence Pill
summary: Two days out from Black Rock City on the flying transport, Yao Lao refines the Blood Lotus Essence Pill, a high-grade fifth-tier pill that perhaps only Gu He could make in the Jia Ma Empire. Using his Heavenly Flame he takes two and a half days instead of ten, and when the pill forms, the anomaly draws the three-tier alchemist's men and other passengers, who demand Xiao Yan hand it over. Xiao Yan fights them, and the Heavenly Flame burns a Da Dou Shi. When one survivor begs to serve him, Yao Lao warns him never to trust such people. At the edge of the Tager Desert, Xiao Yan dreams of Yun Zhi and Nalan Yanran, and Yao Lao tells him to let go of his worries before the Three-year Agreement. At a lonely map shop, Xiao Yan finds a fragment of a map to the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame. The owner, who Yao Lao believes was once a Dou Huang, will not sell it.
